purpose: Application-facing metadata for the local style and palette reference library. Phase 2 defines identifiers and file paths only; no image analysis is performed or implied.

source_pack.note: The source pack is preserved unmodified. Files under assets/images/ are byte-identical copies used by the application.

status_vocabulary.available: An approved local image is mapped to the category and may be displayed.
status_vocabulary.approved: An approved local image is mapped to the category and may be displayed (original source pack).
status_vocabulary.provisional: A local image is mapped but not yet approved for final integration.
status_vocabulary.missing: No approved image exists; the category must not display a substitute.

licensing.origin: Original AI-generated visual reference sheet created for this project.
licensing.redistribution_note: Review applicable platform terms before external redistribution.
licensing.asset_note: Illustrative design inspiration, not verified products or completed client projects.

ai_usage_note: The text-only model receives the selected category identifiers and their textual descriptions. It never receives or analyses the image files.
